solution_summary: amaise was founded in Switzerland in 2019. Its core mission? To tackle one central challenge in the healthcare and insurance sector: the need to process unstructured medical case histories. The data comes from all kinds of sources-including doctor's reports, laboratory findings, expert assessments amaise was looking for a solution that would make the complex processing of unstructured data sets in the healthcare and insurance sector significantly faster and easier. With the aid of Microsoft Azure, amaise is revolutionizing medical insurance claims management. AI models analyze unstructured data and help expensive insurance specialists to make better decisions more quickly - speeding up healthcare and insurance processes and improving the accuracy of outcomes. amaise is a Swiss insurtech startup whose ultra-modern GenAI solution helps insurance companies process and assess medical insurance claims more efficiently.
